name: HYDRA-UMC-TOOL-CLI
build: Go module root is src/. Build with go build ./cmd/hydra-cli from inside src/.
notes: Real `version`/`status`/`robots`/`doctor`/`config validate`/`config apply --dry-run`/`shell` commands, plus `claims`/`claim`/`release`/`limits`/`jog-arm`/`jog` (reservations with a per-session controller id, safety limits read from the server, jog arming; a jog above the model's limit is refused before it is sent). `robots`/`status`/`doctor` are genuine clients of a live HYDRA-UMC-SERVER (GET /api/settings, GET /api/hydra-info). A --config file's own "server"/"timeoutSec" (already schema-validated by `config validate`/`apply`) now really drives every live command's HTTP target and request timeout via resolveTarget(), not just validation - a `shell` session persists both as session defaults too. A real, stable exit-code contract (exitcode.go) classifies every failure (usage/config/network/server/not-implemented/auth) instead of a bare exit 1. The tests use net/http/httptest and real temp-file config fixtures, including `doctor --json`'s structured checkId/severity/status report. Fleet-wide deploy/flash-all/audit commands and a live (non-dry-run) `config apply` remain future work, blocked on HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own fleet write endpoints that don't exist yet.
